name: railway__whoami
description: Get the current authenticated Railway user's profile information

name: railway__list-projects
description: List all Railway projects accessible to the authenticated user

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID to create the project in. If omitted, uses the first available workspace.

isPublic.description: Whether the project should be public (default: false)

name: railway__list-services
description: List all services and environments in a Railway project

projectId.description: The project ID to list services for

name: railway__list-deployments
description: List recent deployments for a Railway project, optionally filtered by environment, service, or status. Returns the most recent first.

status.description: Filter to deployments with this status (e.g. SUCCESS, FAILED, CRASHED, BUILDING, DEPLOYING)

name: railway__get-status
description: Get the deployment status of a Railway project environment. Returns project + environment metadata and, for each service in the environment, its latest deployment status, replica count, and cron schedule. If environmentId is omitted, the project's `production` environment is used when present, otherwise the oldest environment.

environmentId.description: Environment to report on. Defaults to `production` if present, otherwise the project's oldest environment.

name: railway__get-logs
description: Get logs from Railway for a deployment — covers deploy (runtime), build, and http (proxy request) contexts. Pass a specific deploymentId, or pass serviceId + environmentId to resolve the latest deployment. Use `types` to choose which streams to return (default: ['deploy']).

deploymentId.description: A specific deployment ID. If omitted, serviceId and environmentId must be provided to resolve the most recent deployment.

serviceId.description: Service ID (used together with environmentId when deploymentId is not given)

environmentId.description: Environment ID (used together with serviceId when deploymentId is not given)

types.description: Which log streams to fetch. Defaults to ['deploy']. Pass any combination of 'build', 'deploy', and 'http'.

limit.description: Max log entries per stream (default 100, max 500)

filter.description: Optional log filter expression (Loki-style, same syntax as the Railway dashboard). Applies to build and deploy streams.

startDate.description: ISO timestamp for the start of the log window

endDate.description: ISO timestamp for the end of the log window (defaults to now)

name: railway__redeploy
description: Trigger a redeployment of a service in a given environment

environmentId.description: The environment ID to redeploy in

name: railway__accept-deploy
description: DESTRUCTIVE: Commits all staged changes in a Railway environment and triggers a deploy. Only use this when the user has explicitly confirmed they want to deploy.

environmentId.description: The environment ID to commit staged changes for

commitMessage.description: Optional commit message for the deploy

name: railway__railway-agent
description: Send a message to Railway's AI agent for complex infrastructure operations. The agent can inspect services, diagnose issues, and take actions on your behalf.

message.description: The message to send to the agent

threadId.description: Thread ID to continue an existing conversation. Omit to start a new one.

serviceId.description: Optional service ID to scope the agent's context
